exposure: timing of opening of the uterine isthmus
early opening of the uterine isthmus (before 25 weeks of gestation)
late opening of the uterine isthmus (after 25 weeks of gestation)
outcome: Emergency caesarean section due to active bleeding
cohort: Patients with placenta previa, diagnosed between 20 and 22 weeks of gestation
finding: Placenta previa was associated with a high risk of bleeding leading to emergency caesarean section during pregnancy, and massive haemorrhage during caesarean section in patients in whom the uterine isthmus opened before 25 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section due to active bleeding was performed more frequently in the EO-previa group (48%) than in the LO-previa group (25%) (p=0.021).
